name: @roxybrowser/openapi
description: MCP server for RoxyBrowser automation - manage browser instances and get CDP endpoints

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test $(find src/api src/sdk src/domains src/mcp -name '*.test.mjs' -print)
scripts.coverage: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=lib/api/** --test-coverage-include=lib/sdk/** --test-coverage-include=lib/domains/** --test-coverage-include=lib/mcp/** --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-functions=90 --test-coverage-branches=90 $(find src/api src/sdk src/domains src/mcp -name '*.test.mjs' -print)
scripts.inspect: npm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector -e ROXY_API_KEY=your_api_key_here -e ROXY_API_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:50000 node lib/cli/browser.js
scripts.inspect:cli: npm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --cli node lib/cli/browser.js
scripts.publish:release: npm run clean && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish
scripts.publish:beta: npm version prerelease --preid=beta --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --tag beta

author: RoxyBrowser
